description: This Kotlin source file defines an Android activity called SplashActivity. It displays a splash screen with a stylized title 'Hello TV' and a color-accented underline, using a gradient background. The splash screen stays visible for 5 seconds before fading out and transitioning to MainActivity, with considerations for Android TV safe areas and visual accessibility.

classes.name: SplashActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that displays a styled splash screen with a countdown timer, then navigates to the main screen.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the splash screen UI components, animations, and the delayed transition to the main activity.

methods.name: createSplashGradient
methods.description: Generates a gradient drawable background for the splash screen, transitioning from a deep ocean blue to a light article background color.

methods.name: dpToPx
methods.description: Converts density-independent pixels (dp) to raw pixel units based on device screen density.
